svg.title: Hen house wiring overview
svg.desc: ESP32-S3 in the centre with the I2C devices above, inputs on the left, outputs on the right and the power chain below.
svg.text: ESP32 in the centre, everything it talks to around it. Each blue line is a bundle: the pins are written on it.
Powered by 5 V from the LM2596
I2C bus: 4 devices share the same 4 wires
12 V in, 5.0 V out (set it first)
12 V also goes to the L298N and XY-MOS (red badges).
Every device has its own wire pair back to the
